verdict.rationale: Rive's docs explicitly describe creating a component once and using customized instances throughout a file, with changes to the source component propagating to all instances — exactly the reusable-component-with-variants/overrides workflow described in the story. This is corroborated by related data-binding and view-model docs showing per-instance customization stays linked to source data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on designer confirmation of variant-override behavior beyond first-party docs, and explicit detail on 'variants' terminology (only 'instances' is used).
